comments_data.body:
Thanks @lilitkarapetyan - I was expecting you to have to stick in the '.node' files for Marcos/Linux too.  I "think" this PR will only provide executables for windows 

Here is the lib file for macos:
[node_sqlite3.node_macos.zip](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/files/8897672/node_sqlite3.node_macos.zip)

Here is the lib file for ubuntu: 
[node_sqlite3.node_linux.zip](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/files/8898409/node_sqlite3.node_linux.zip)

Here is the executable running on linux:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/173544159-2f8c9925-0b37-49ca-b336-85d8f04545b1.png)

I've checked out the branch on macos, run `yarn install`, then `yarn build`, then `yarn pkg-build`.   But, when I copy the windows executable to ms-windows, it fails like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/173569387-9d7a8e27-59f1-4808-8626-df8139fc1817.png)

> @IanMayo This one works for macos arm64 architecture 👍 We should create a new folder under `packages/executable/sqlite3.nodes` for arm64, then update the `packages/executable/helpers/pkhCopyCrossPlatforms.js` too.

Could you make that change, in this PR please @lebaphi ?  That's because @lilitkarapetyan wouldn't be able to test that `arm64` is working correctly.

Hello @lebaphi , one more change, please.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/173800974-36db54aa-f7bb-4a75-8908-1ace96dbe768.png)

We create two files called `executable-macos`. Could the first one be called `executable-macos-arm64` please?

Hello @lilitkarapetyan - I get this error when I run the current built executable on MS-Windows:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/173803404-094c66d0-aef2-4b67-a5d4-fba4e5203f2e.png)

Could you please check if it works for you?
I have win64 installed and it works without errors.

> I have win64 installed and it works without errors.

Ok. It ran fine on a Windows VM on Intel Macos.  It failed on Windows VM on ARM Macos.

> 
Hi Ian,
Do you use win32 or win64 on  ARM Macos?

> Do you use win32 or win64 on ARM Macos?

Aah, it _looks like_ the problem could be that it's 64-Bit ARM version of windows :-(

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174028667-051965f1-26ea-4910-a60c-f3e29853c30e.png)

That's certainly not a target we formally need to support.

I am probably worrying over nothing, but.

In this line I don't see a target for `macos-arm64`.  Can @lilitkarapetyan or @lebaphi explain why it isn't there?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174034036-93157500-c265-4124-82a6-930d26d6f2b5.png)

One more thing, for @lebaphi:
Could you change the build description so it's clear which is `executable-macos` and which is `executable-macos-arm64`?  I did try to do this myself, but broke the build.  The reason for this, is that I want it to be quite clear where errors occur.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174034460-8839e919-bcdf-4a9e-b3e0-5457a2647df1.png)

> I am probably worrying over nothing, but.
> 
> In this line I don't see a target for `macos-arm64`. Can @lilitkarapetyan or @lebaphi explain why it isn't there?
> 
> ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174034036-93157500-c265-4124-82a6-930d26d6f2b5.png)
> 
> One more thing, for @lebaphi: Could you change the build description so it's clear which is `executable-macos` and which is `executable-macos-arm64`? I did try to do this myself, but broke the build. The reason for this, is that I want it to be quite clear where errors occur. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/174034460-8839e919-bcdf-4a9e-b3e0-5457a2647df1.png)

Hi @IanMayo, executable for mac os can run on intel chip and arm64 chip, so we just need to build 1 version and use for both. Only sqlite3.node file needs to be built with its correct architecture.

issues.title: Windows & Linux executables failing
issues.body:
I've run `yarn pkg-build` on the `develop` branch.  I then copied the Windows executable to a `Windows 11` Virtual machine.

When I run the executable from `Windows Explorer` it silently fails.

When I run it from Command Prompt, it fails with this error:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/172627836-c488a566-1613-4335-94d0-bbf6bd9a04e8.png)

The users are planning on running a wargame next week, and are keen on getting a test-able version on their network.

Ooops, it's also failing on Linuex:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/172630857-6381c215-e44a-460a-aaf0-a25d9a59e0cb.png)

Note: I also downloaded a CI build from this PR, and it failed with the same error:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/actions/runs/2455919188

Ok. I ran the CI build on an old Windows 10 PC, and got this error. It gives more detail:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/172825342-5d2b77e4-4091-4c81-8edc-81fc4d0ad6f3.png)

comments.body:
Here's a recording of the issue on MS-Windows:
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/4f9b6365964da0742c1bdf8d8a8d7dc3.gif)

Ok, @lebaphi resolved it:

> I think the root cause is the node_sqlite3.node file is not consistent with node 16, 
> because it was build with node 14 (in executable/sqlite3.nodes)
> so we need to copy the new one which consistent with node 16 then it will work

Phi can produce `sqlite3.node` files for `macos` and `linux`, and hopefully @lilitkarapetyan will produce one for `windows`.

@lebaphi - if you zip up the `.node` files and attach them to this issue, then @lilitkarapetyan  can include them in a PR.

@IanMayo I just have the file for Macos, I think @lilitkarapetyan has files for windows and linux 👍 

[node_sqlite3.node_macos.zip](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/files/8896112/node_sqlite3.node_macos.zip)
Thanks @lebaphi - I'm just finishing the linux version.  I'll pass it to @lilitkarapetyan  in her Pull Request.
